scope: Prepare for v3 main merge, remove beta tags, configure GitHub Pages docs, and create PR

tasks.title: Remove Beta Tags and Prepare for v3.0.0 Stable
tasks.description: Audit package.json, package-lock.json, README.md, docs-site/package.json, and docs-site/src/data/siteMeta.json. Strip out '3.0.0-beta.x' versions and update them to the stable '3.0.0'. Ensure all textual references to 'beta' are removed from the docs and README.

tasks.title: Configure Docs Site for GitHub Pages Deployment
tasks.description: Update docs-site/next.config.mjs to ensure it works on GitHub Pages. Add `basePath: '/node-pptx-templater'` and `assetPrefix: '/node-pptx-templater/'` (or conditionally inject via environment variables). Ensure the GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/docs.yml) is properly configured with GitHub Pages deployment steps and permissions.

tasks.title: Pre-Merge Verification & Memory Update
tasks.description: Run `npm test`, `npm run lint`, and `npm --prefix docs-site run build` to ensure zero regressions. Update .agent/project_summary.md and CHANGELOG.md to reflect the stable v3.0.0 transition.

tasks.title: Create Pull Request to Main Branch
tasks.description: Stage all modified files, commit with message 'chore: release v3.0.0 stable', push to the remote branch, and utilize the GitHub CLI to generate a pull request into the main branch.
